layoutgen_reference_reuse_decision.what_it_solves: Provides a known SRAM-like macro silhouette with dense array core, row side periphery, and column side periphery.

layoutgen_reference_reuse_decision.expected_effect_on_complete_gds: Improves region proportions and macro-side organization.
layoutgen_reference_reuse_decision.risk_if_reused_wrongly: Would regress ownership to old layoutgen output instead of current OpenYield module/pin mapping.

layoutgen_reference_reuse_decision.expected_effect_on_complete_gds: Helps keep array, dummy, and replica physically meaningful.
